shape.level: wind_db[m] is 10 log10 of W_m(f) on the flat part (f <= corner), in the model's periodogram units; W_m is static (no speed law, no channel gain) and is added to the floor

frozen.profiles: frozen up to the per-rotor line gain: profile_*_db[r] = bench + g_r
frozen.rule: L_r = v4.expected_periodogram of the bench payload with the floor off (mean_db -10000, static_rel 0) and the other rotors' profiles at -10000 dB, per frame; sum_r L_r = all-rotor L to 1e-09

flight_stage.band_rule: the bench payload's band_hz: the bench Whittle's band (bench_v4.BAND_HZ)

pool.units: |rfft(w x)|^2 / sum w^2, one-sided; no channel gains

start.floor_rule: per band bin: quantile FLOOR_INIT_QUANTILE (+ FLOOR_INIT_DB_CORRECTION) over mics and frames of max(I - L - W0, 0.1 I) / sum_r h_rm s_rn^b at the bench b; least squares on the controls; z the bench's ridge solve

wind_start.rule: nv3r4 wind_db + its channel gain (its data were divided by 10^{g/10}); a start, not a prior

floor_mean.rule: bench_v4 floor-mean prior; centre the mean of the floor measured on this pool

priors.floor_z: N(0, I); control values mean_db + shape_sd_db (L z)

wind.rule: nv3r4 (PRIOR_SETS['v4'], --wind): fit._wind_centres, the per-mic low-band excess, here on the unnormalised pool

shape.level: wind_db[m] is 10 log10 of W_m(f) on the flat part (f <= corner), in the model's periodogram units; W_m is static (no speed law, no channel gain) and is added to the floor

priors.floor_push: +kappa sum_j ctrl_j on the log prior (dB)

line_gain.rule: per rotor, on both line families; centred on the bench level, a 6 dB scale for the bench -> flight level change (four rotors in flight vs one on the bench)

convergence.test: a fresh-memory pass after the first: gain per cell < tol AND every group's max movement < its tolerance
